label: node addition
type: the cluster-initiated way to grow a cluster: an existing cluster adds a named node to itself over a secure connection (since 7.1 the `http://` scheme and port 8091 cannot be used), after which a rebalance is required. Erases all prior provisioning on the added node - buckets, services and settings.
evidence: Following node-addition, _rebalance_ is required, to make the new node an active member of the cluster.
The scheme `http://` cannot be used, nor can the port `8091`: since in 7.1 and later versions, addition must occur over a secure connection.
All aspects of _provisioning_ that may previously have occurred on the new node are eliminated: this includes buckets, services, and settings.
note: Promoted as the counterpart of server:node-join; the two are documented as having equivalent effect from opposite directions, and the distinction is which side initiates.
